{{Quote|The slackness of the New Republic is responsible for the terrible conditions on Algara. I hope to change that, and bring the discipline and classless socirty of the Empire to this place!|Onstruk Don|<ref name="PoG2" />}}
[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] '''Onstruk Don''' was the leader of the [[Imperial Resistance]] on [[Algara II]] during the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Biography==
Onstruk Don was a [[Belligerency|Belligerent]] and grew disgusted with the rigid social system and the injustice shown to the [[Xan/Legends|Xan]] under the complicated social structure on Algara II. He managed to organize the [[Imperial Resistance]] against the [[Algarian Bureaucracy]] and their [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] allies..

==Personality and traits==
Onstruk was a man of compassion with a hunger for justice. He was a brilliant tactician, and an expert in demolitions.
